effects.name: Cinematic Golden Hour Horizon Reveal
effects.purpose: Establish visual hierarchy and emotional calm as sections enter the viewport.
effects.desktopBehavior: Graceful staggered entrance of container elements with 50ms child offset.
effects.mobileBehavior: Translation reduced to 8px, duration compressed to 280ms.
effects.reducedMotionBehavior: Opacity fade only (150ms) with zero translation or scaling.
effects.accessibilityRequirements: Content remains readable and accessible if observer is delayed. No layout shift.
effects.performanceBudget: Max JS execution < 1.0ms; GPU compositor-only properties.
forbiddenTechnology: Framer Motion on standard text blocks, GSAP on basic sections
effects.riskNotes: Avoid re-triggering on small scroll oscillations. Use 'once: true'.

effects.name: Multi-Plane Atmospheric Depth Parallax
effects.purpose: Create subtle optical depth between foreground manuscripts, central prism, and background mist.
effects.trigger: Continuous passive scroll progress within viewport bounds.
effects.desktopBehavior: Subtle 2.5D layer separation; clamped strictly to +/- 24px.
effects.accessibilityRequirements: Never displace text layers over high-contrast edges. Headline text stays stationary.
effects.performanceBudget: Zero main thread layout. Transform translateY only via passive rAF.
effects.preferredTechnology: CSS (transform translateY via CSS variables updated in rAF)
forbiddenTechnology: Scroll-jacking, wheel interception, Three.js camera rigs
effects.riskNotes: Disallowed on high-density cards to prevent motion sickness.

effects.name: Crystalline Caustic Light Sweep
effects.purpose: Signature optical accent reflecting light through the 4-pillar Evidence Prism facet.
effects.trigger: Controlled idle loop (every 8s) or subtle pointer movement over hero facet.
effects.amplitude: Linear gradient sweep across 120% element width; max opacity 0.35.
effects.desktopBehavior: Soft spectral sweep passes across crystal edges; pauses when pointer leaves facet.
effects.tabletBehavior: Single scheduled sweep on section entry; no pointer tracking.
effects.mobileBehavior: Single static spectral sheen on image edge; zero continuous animation.
effects.reducedMotionBehavior: Static spectral border accent (0.2 opacity); animation disabled.
effects.accessibilityRequirements: Luminance contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 preserved for all overlapping typography. No strobe risk.
effects.performanceBudget: Composited CSS transform on pseudo-element with will-change: transform.
forbiddenTechnology: WebGL shader canvas, heavy Three.js caustics simulation
effects.riskNotes: Must never obscure headline text or cause color flicker.

effects.name: Frosted Knowledge Plate Reveal
effects.purpose: Present verified evidence cards, AI synthesis panels, and expert dossiers with tactile dignity.
effects.trigger: Card hover, focus-visible, or scroll entrance.
effects.desktopBehavior: Card elevates 4px with quiet glow token enhancement and crisp border emphasis.
effects.tabletBehavior: Active tap elevation 2px; zero continuous perspective tilt.
effects.mobileBehavior: Elevation translateY(-2px), flat surface opacity rgba(18, 24, 36, 0.95), tilt disabled.
effects.reducedMotionBehavior: Border color and elevation shadow change without transform translation.
effects.accessibilityRequirements: Full keyboard focus-visible ring (2px solid #3b82f6) must remain unclipped.
effects.riskNotes: Overlapping backdrop-filters cause severe GPU composite thrashing. Rule: 0–8px max for cards; 12px is hero ceiling only; stacked blur is strictly forbidden.

effects.name: Editorial Scroll Choreography (Landing & Cases Desktop)
effects.purpose: Direct editorial focus during sequential investigation timeline reading.
effects.durationToken: Synchronized to scroll velocity (duration.section for enter)
effects.amplitude: Horizontal scroll translation bounded to container width (desktop only).
effects.desktopBehavior: Landing: allowed for one narrative section. Cases: allowed only for an optional desktop archival timeline if Phase C usability verifies it. Native scroll strictly preserved (zero wheel interception).
effects.tabletBehavior: Converts to native touch horizontal snap container.
effects.mobileBehavior: Strictly unpinned standard vertical document flow (position: static). Zero horizontal pinning.
effects.reducedMotionBehavior: Standard vertical document flow. Zero sticky pin delays.
effects.accessibilityRequirements: Full keyboard arrow navigation between case items; skip link to jump past pinned section.
effects.performanceBudget: CSS position: sticky + transform: translateX via CSS variable.
effects.preferredTechnology: CSS (position: sticky + CSS scroll-driven animations or light rAF)
effects.fallbackTechnology: GSAP ScrollTrigger (Desktop only, if complex pinning requires scrub synchronization)
forbiddenTechnology: Wheel event hijacking, body overflow: hidden locks
effects.riskNotes: Must allow rapid scroll-through without trapping the user.

effects.name: Draggable Spatial Exploration Markers
effects.purpose: Provide interactive hotspots on the Knowledge Atlas and Case Archive to explore verified dossiers.
effects.trigger: User pointer drag, marker click, or keyboard Enter on focused hotspot.
effects.durationToken: duration.feedback (150ms for marker, 320ms for dossier reveal)
effects.desktopBehavior: Markers float above canvas map; clicking marker opens side dossier card with focus lock.
effects.tabletBehavior: Touch drag across canvas with minimum 44x44px touch targets.
effects.mobileBehavior: Canvas replaced or augmented by horizontal swipeable dossier cards with indicator dots.
effects.reducedMotionBehavior: Immediate popover display without scale pulses or slide transitions.
effects.accessibilityRequirements: Hotspots are native <button> elements with aria-label, aria-expanded, and Escape key dismissal.
effects.performanceBudget: Zero reflow during drag. Use pointer events and CSS transform.
effects.preferredTechnology: DOM_INTERACTION (Native HTML buttons + SVG canvas overlay)
forbiddenTechnology: Canvas-only rendered hotspots (which break screen reader accessibility)
effects.riskNotes: Dossier text must be real DOM, never drawn on bitmap.

effects.name: Ambient Celestial Field (Landing Hero Bounded)
effects.purpose: Provide contemplative atmosphere of library sunbeams and academic depth.
effects.trigger: Active page load when in viewport.
effects.desktopBehavior: Landing hero background only: maximum 3 drifting SVG particles. Slow 12s keyframe drift. Pauses cleanly when offscreen via IntersectionObserver.
effects.accessibilityRequirements: Background elements must be aria-hidden='true' with pointer-events: none.
effects.performanceBudget: 0 JS work / frame (CSS keyframe only); pauses when offscreen
forbiddenTechnology: Heavy Canvas particle physics engines, Three.js point clouds
effects.riskNotes: Limited to Landing hero only. Disallowed across all other surfaces.

effects.name: Magnetic Tactile Buttons with Double-Line Roll
effects.purpose: Elevate strategic primary actions with inviting, responsive tactile feedback.
effects.amplitude: Button body translates max 6px toward pointer; text shifts max 2px.
effects.desktopBehavior: Button shifts toward cursor within small bounded radius; springs back on pointer leave.
effects.reducedMotionBehavior: DISABLED. Standard CSS hover color transition only.
effects.accessibilityRequirements: Keyboard focus states completely independent of pointer tracking. Never delay click action.
effects.performanceBudget: Calculated via mousemove throttled to rAF; transform translated via CSS variable.
effects.preferredTechnology: CSS hover + optional lightweight pointer listener on single primary CTA
forbiddenTechnology: Site-wide magnetic wrappers on all links/buttons
effects.riskNotes: Only 1 CTA per page may use magnetic effect.

effects.name: Curated Archival Glass Frame
effects.purpose: Unify photography and concept illustrations into museum-grade academic media plates.
effects.trigger: DOM render and responsive container resize.
effects.amplitude: Subtle inner shadow and 1px crisp border token containment.
effects.desktopBehavior: Framed presentation with calibrated aspect ratios and optical caption anchors.
effects.tabletBehavior: Same as desktop; preserves aspect ratio.
effects.mobileBehavior: Maintains correct focal crop (e.g. 4:5 on portrait, 16:9 on landscape).
effects.accessibilityRequirements: Image has descriptive alt text; caption has proper <figcaption> semantic markup.
effects.performanceBudget: Pure CSS layout and borders. Zero runtime cost.
effects.riskNotes: Mandatory framing wrapper across all displayed visual assets.

effects.name: Chaotic Stream Convergence
effects.purpose: Visually manifest the core thesis: chaotic data flows into the prism, resolving into verified truth.
effects.trigger: Scroll progress across the Trust transition section.
effects.amplitude: 3 distinct paper stream lines converge from -40px offset into central focal ray.
effects.desktopBehavior: As user scrolls, scattered fragment trajectories converge into the crystal prism vertex.
effects.tabletBehavior: Stepwise scroll reveal of before/after state.
effects.mobileBehavior: Static two-stage visual reveal (Chaotic input card -> Arrow -> Verified output card).
effects.reducedMotionBehavior: Static side-by-side comparison cards with zero scroll scrub animation.
effects.accessibilityRequirements: Semantic text explanation accompanies visual: 'Transforming chaotic questions into structured evidence.'
effects.performanceBudget: SVG path stroke-dashoffset or transform translateY; max 2 redraws per frame.
effects.fallbackTechnology: GSAP ScrollTrigger (Only if CSS scroll-driven progress fails in target browser matrix)
forbiddenTechnology: Canvas particle physics simulations, WebGL fluid shaders
effects.riskNotes: Must not lock scroll or create sluggish scroll resistance.

effects.name: Interactive Annotation & Verdict Stamp
effects.purpose: Visually reinforce that AI suggests, evidence supports, and human experts provide authoritative review.
effects.trigger: Stepwise tab selection or verdict interaction.
effects.amplitude: Annotation stroke draw-in 100ms, verdict stamp scale 1.08 -> 1.00 (150ms).
effects.desktopBehavior: Displays document preview; clicking 'Review Step' draws annotation trail to verified seal.
effects.tabletBehavior: Same interactive sequence with touch targets.
effects.mobileBehavior: Tabbed horizontal view: Tab 1 'AI Extraction' -> Tab 2 'Evidence Links' -> Tab 3 'Human Decision'.
effects.reducedMotionBehavior: Instant state switch between steps; stamp appears without scale pulse.
effects.accessibilityRequirements: Step indicators have aria-current='step', tablist semantics, and keyboard arrow keys.
effects.performanceBudget: Standard DOM state transitions. JS time < 2ms.
forbiddenTechnology: Fake handwritten SVG canvas simulations that cannot be parsed by screen readers
effects.riskNotes: All reviewed text in prototype must be clearly identified as synthetic illustrative examples.

effects.name: Interactive Knowledge Atlas Orrery (2.5D)
effects.purpose: Planetary domain constellation map rendered via 2.5D SVG vectors and CSS orbital drift.
effects.durationToken: Continuous ambient rotation (30s cycle) + instant node hover/selection (180ms)
effects.amplitude: Node orbital radius 80-160px; hover node scale 1.10.
effects.desktopBehavior: 5 primary domain spheres (Science, Tech, Society, Culture, Economy) orbit the central Evidence Prism.
effects.tabletBehavior: Static planetary alignment with touch-selectable nodes.
effects.mobileBehavior: Horizontal swipeable domain cards with summary metrics; orbital canvas replaced by card carousel.
effects.reducedMotionBehavior: Static SVG diagram showing all 5 nodes connected with clear static lines.
effects.accessibilityRequirements: Each node is a keyboard-focusable button (<button>); accompanied by an accessible HTML data table/list.
effects.performanceBudget: SVG group transform or lightweight 2D canvas (< 100 nodes). Offscreen pause mandatory.
effects.fallbackTechnology: HTML5 2D Canvas (Only if dynamic node count exceeds 50 nodes)
effects.riskNotes: Engineered as declarative 2.5D SVG graph to eliminate WebGL context crashes and excessive GPU memory pressure.
